mapper.sql: select s.store_id, s.store_code, s.store_name, s.store_type, s.manager_name, s.phone, s.province, s.city, s.address, s.business_hours, s.pet_capacity, s.open_date, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, (select count(*) from pet_info p where p.store_id = s.store_id) as pet_count, (select count(*) from pet_staff st where st.store_id = s.store_id and st.del_flag = '0') as staff_count, (select count(*) from pet_customer c where c.store_id = s.store_id and c.del_flag = '0') as customer_count from pet_store s
mapper.insert: insert into pet_store( store_code, store_name, store_type, manager_name, phone, province, city, address, business_hours, pet_capacity, open_date, status, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{storeCode}, #{storeName}, #{storeType}, #{managerName}, #{phone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{address}, #{businessHours}, #{petCapacity}, #{openDate}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
